svg.title: Jenkins upgrade check
svg.desc: One bar per Jenkins LTS line from 2.60.3 to 2.568.3, upgraded to 2.580.2 with the 300 most installed plugins. Replacing only the core, Jenkins does not start from 12 lines and starts with plugins failing from 12; 13.6% of reporting controllers are on those lines. Going through the planned stops, 38 of 38 load every plugin.
